about: A Navi chip of BN5's whose code moved into BN6's engine (issue #82's C3; docs/multirom/chips-code.md, the Navi chips past nine bits): BN5's CanladEX held paralysed (hold: each game's own status step, the same bits in both) at (5,2), MegaMan with a folder of one GridManDS F and 29 Cannon A in both games, the GridManDS dealt first (a Mega chip: a folder of them alone never deals), BN5's chip 277 by BN5's own code and the registry's 523 by the same code moved (BN5's Navi routine 0x12 as BN6's 0x2f: his battle sprite BN5's own, list 2's 0x12, LZ77 there and queued, copied whole at a number of the chips' in BN6's list 2; his tackle's effect, the fourth kind's 0x58, moved with it), the first Custom screen's chip picked and OK, used at t30: every difference of BN6's play from BN5's fails it (docs/multirom/chips-code.md). MegaMan dark as the battle begins in both (BN5's meter under 470, BN6's engine the same through src/emu/soulmood.c with KnightSoul held), so BN5's gate lets the DS out: its power BN5's computed one (0x0800E9A8, PowerDS moved, BN5's power 1041) by the side's battle counter 3.
